audiograms.name: Mild-to-moderate sloping loss
audiograms.blurb: Gentle high-frequency (presbycusis-like) slope. Lows near normal, highs down ~55-65 dB.

audiograms.name: Moderate flat loss (~40-45 dB)
audiograms.blurb: Roughly equal loss across frequency — the 40 dB example: a 0 dB input is lifted to ~40 dB, louder sounds compress above it.

audiograms.name: Steep ski-slope loss
audiograms.blurb: Near-normal lows crashing to a severe high-frequency loss — lots of gain and heavy compression up top.
